claims: Víctor Martínez ("V-Mart") is a retired Venezuelan MLB catcher and designated hitter.
Víctor Martínez played for the Cleveland Indians from 2002 to 2009.
Víctor Martínez played for the Boston Red Sox from 2009 to 2010.
Víctor Martínez played for the Detroit Tigers from 2011 to 2018.
Víctor Martínez finished his career with a .295 average.
In 2014, Víctor Martínez signed a four-year, $68 million contract extension with the Detroit Tigers.
Víctor Martínez finished his 16-year career with 246 home runs.
Víctor Martínez finished his 16-year career with 1,178 RBI.
Víctor Martínez is a two-time Silver Slugger Award winner.
Víctor Martínez retired after the 2018 season.
This information refers to the Major League Baseball player Víctor Martínez and is not related to the pro bodybuilder of the same name.
